records.name: Imperator Endgültigst
records.biography_en: Rules the known universe and remains irritated by the part called other. His HyperNorm sceptre governs every known orbit and several disputed intentions. A dissonant card asks whether the unknown is allowed to remain unclaimed. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Andere liegt knapp außerhalb des genehmigten Universums.

variant_notes.note_en: Rules the known universe and remains irritated by the part called other.

records.name: Sidekick Zustimmotron
records.biography_en: Has calculated the correct response and would like a moment to feel it. His three HyperNorm lights calculate a suitable reply before the feeling arrives. A dissonant card waits through the delay without reporting a malfunction. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Zustimmung ist berechnet. Ihre Empfindung folgt später.

variant_notes.note_en: Has calculated the correct response and would like a moment to feel it.

records.name: Duellantin Lichtkante
records.biography_en: Can defend a position more quickly than she can decide whether it is hers. Her HyperNorm blade wins arguments at the speed of a confident gesture. A dissonant card asks who chose the position she is defending. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Haltung ist verteidigt. Ihre Herkunft wird geprüft.

variant_notes.note_en: Can defend a position more quickly than she can decide whether it is hers.

records.name: Botschafter Anderswo
records.biography_en: Has translated the greeting correctly and is still waiting for the welcome. His HyperNorm treaty translates three approved meanings into three unfamiliar dots. A dissonant card offers a welcome that does not require prior equivalence. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Übersetzung ist korrekt. Die Begrüßung steht noch aus.

variant_notes.note_en: Has translated the greeting correctly and is still waiting for the welcome.

records.name: Kapitänin Kursungefähr
records.biography_en: Keeps the crew moving while command argues about the direction of progress. Her HyperNorm chart keeps the crew moving through revisions called progress. A dissonant card asks whether checking on a tired crewmate could count as a useful course. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Richtung wurde bis zur nächsten Lagebesprechung beibehalten.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps the crew moving while command argues about the direction of progress.

records.name: Lochesser Restkosmos
records.biography_en: Has found a solution to the leftovers that may include the rest of the kitchen. His HyperNorm spoon carries a cosmic solution to everything left over. A dissonant card asks what will remain available after he finishes simplifying. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Resteverwertung schließt das übrige Inventar möglicherweise ein.

variant_notes.note_en: Has found a solution to the leftovers that may include the rest of the kitchen.
